domain: GFR 2017 / CVC — Mandatory Clause & Annexure Selection

mandatoryClauses.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
mandatoryClauses.reason: EMD is mandatory for goods/works procurement per GFR Rule 170 (2% of estimated value); MSE-registered bidders are exempt per MSME Act Section 11B.

mandatoryClauses.title: Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG)
mandatoryClauses.reason: PBG is mandatory on contract award per GFR Rule 171, regardless of category or value.

mandatoryClauses.title: Integrity Pact
mandatoryClauses.reason: CVC guidelines mandate an Integrity Pact for tenders valued at Rs. 1 Crore or above.

mandatoryClauses.title: MSE Participation & Exemption
mandatoryClauses.reason: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012 — always stated regardless of category or value.
